methods.label: Apply difference of squares twice
methods.explanation: \(x^4-16=(x^2+4)(x^2-4)\), where \(x^2-4\) can be factored further as \((x+2)(x-2)\), and \(x^2+4\) cannot be factored further.
methods.levelReason: Both factorization steps use the same Grade 8 difference-of-squares identity.
